already_reported: You already reported this. We are looking into it and will let you know.

sample_required: The sample has to be finished first: every item needs a judgement.

address_mismatch: This is not the address you confirmed before.
anchor_not_unique: An institution address belongs to more than one account. The payout waits.
interest_declared: You already declared an interest in this item. A second reviewer takes over.
